fields.hero_headline: The ultimate AI fitting room for modern fashion brands
fields.hero_subheadline: Stop dealing with returns due to poor sizing. Aura uses state-of-the-art Generative AI and Computer Vision to let your customers try on your entire catalog virtually.
fields.footer_text: © 2026 Aura Virtual Try-On. All rights reserved.

fields.title: Reduce Return Rates
fields.description: Customers who can visualize the fit are 40% less likely to return items due to sizing issues, saving you thousands in reverse logistics.

fields.title: Boost Conversion
fields.description: Increase buyer confidence. Shoppers who use virtual try-on are 3x more likely to complete their purchase.

fields.title: Plug & Play Storefront
fields.description: Launch your own virtual storefront in minutes without writing a single line of code. Simply upload your catalog and go.

fields.title: Frictionless Guest Mode
fields.description: No account required. Upload a photo and see yourself in any outfit instantly. Your privacy is protected.

fields.title: Personalized Fit
fields.description: Our AI analyzes your body proportions to recommend the absolute perfect size for your unique body type.

fields.title: Hyper-Realistic AI
fields.description: We use state of the art diffusion models to ensure the lighting, drape, and texture of the clothes look real.

fields.title: Features
fields.content:
Next-Generation Virtual Try-On

Aura utilizes advanced Generative AI and diffusion models to map garments onto diverse body types in milliseconds.

Neural Fabric Physics

Our engine simulates realistic drape, lighting, and texture. Silk looks like silk; wool looks like wool.

Sub-Second Processing

Deliver stunning imagery without making your shoppers wait. Average inference time is under 800ms.

fields.title: Integration API
fields.content:
Developer API Documentation

Integrate Aura seamlessly into Shopify, WooCommerce, or custom React/Next.js storefronts.

POST /api/v1/try-on


// Request Payload

{

"user_image_url": "https://example.com/user.jpg",

"garment_image_url": "https://example.com/shirt.jpg",

"category": "upper_body"

}

Authentication

All requests require an API key passed in the Authorization: Bearer header.

fields.title: Webhooks
fields.content:
Event-Driven Webhooks

Subscribe to real-time events to keep your backend systems synchronized without polling.

  • try_on.completed: Triggered when an image synthesis is successfully finished.
  • try_on.failed: Triggered if processing fails due to unreadable images.
  • garment.indexed: Triggered when a new catalog item finishes ML indexing.

fields.content:

fields.title: About Us
fields.content:
Our Mission

Aura was founded with a singular vision: to eliminate the guesswork from online shopping. We believe that by bridging the gap between digital retail and physical fitting rooms through cutting-edge Generative AI, we can drastically reduce the environmental impact of fashion returns while delivering joy to consumers.

The Team

Our team consists of leading AI researchers, computer vision experts, and e-commerce veterans who have built systems processing millions of transactions at Fortune 500 retailers.

fields.title: Privacy Policy
fields.content:
Privacy Policy

Last Updated: August 10, 2026

1. Data Collection

We collect images submitted by end-users exclusively for the purpose of generating virtual try-on results. We do not use customer images to train our base AI models. Images are stored securely on encrypted volumes and are automatically purged after 24 hours.

2. Third-Party Processors

We utilize Google Cloud and AWS for secure cloud hosting. All data processing occurs within SOC2 compliant data centers.

fields.title: Terms of Service
fields.content:
Terms of Service

Last Updated: August 10, 2026

1. License Grant

Subject to these Terms, Aura grants you a non-exclusive, non-transferable license to access and use the Aura API solely for integrating virtual try-on capabilities into your authorized web or mobile applications.

2. SLA Limitations

We strive for 99.9% uptime. Scheduled maintenance will be announced at least 48 hours in advance via our status page.

fields.title: Cookie Policy
fields.content:
Cookie Policy

We use cookies to improve your experience on our platform.

  • Essential Cookies: Required for the dashboard authentication and basic site functionality.
  • Analytics Cookies: We use minimal analytics to understand API usage and dashboard traffic patterns.

fields.title: Security Audit
fields.content:
Enterprise Security

Security is fundamentally baked into the Aura platform from day one. We undergo rigorous penetration testing and compliance auditing.

SOC 2 Type II Certified ISO 27001 Compliant PCI DSS Level 1

Encryption at Rest and in Transit

All data is encrypted in transit using TLS 1.3 and at rest using AES-256 encryption managed via AWS KMS.

fields.title: GDPR Compliance
fields.content:
GDPR Compliance

Aura is fully committed to the rights of individuals under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

Data Processing Agreements (DPA)

For our enterprise customers operating in the EU, we offer standard Data Processing Agreements that outline our commitments as a Data Processor. Please reach out to legal@aura.example.com to execute a DPA.

fields.name: Lumina
fields.description: Minimalist, large imagery, sleek typography perfect for clothing and accessories.

fields.name: ElectroPro
fields.description: Clean, high-contrast, structured grid ideal for gadgets and tech products.

fields.name: Glow
fields.description: Soft color palettes, elegant fonts, and whitespace-heavy for makeup and skincare.

fields.name: Habitat
fields.description: Earthy tones, lifestyle focus, masonry layouts for furniture and decor.

fields.name: Velocity
fields.description: High energy, bold typography, vibrant accents for sports gear and activewear.

fields.name: Vogue Elegance
fields.description: A high-end, editorial template designed for luxury fashion and designer labels. Features high contrast and elegant serif typography.

fields.name: Urban Street
fields.description: A brutalist, dark-mode-first template built for hypebeast culture and modern streetwear brands. Features neon accents and bold layouts.

fields.name: Nordic Minimal
fields.description: An ultra-clean, whitespace-heavy template perfect for sustainable, organic, or minimalist apparel brands seeking a refined aesthetic.

fields.name: Heritage Vintage
fields.description: A warm, retro-inspired template with sepia tones and classic typography. Perfect for thrift, vintage, and heritage goods.

fields.name: Apex Athletic
fields.description: A high-energy, dynamic template engineered for activewear and performance tech brands. Features sharp angles and vibrant colors.

fields.name: Neon Cyberpunk
fields.description: A futuristic, dark-mode template with neon magenta and cyan accents, glitch hover effects, scanline overlays, and monospace terminal-style typography. Perfect for techwear and cyberpunk fashion.

fields.name: Y2K Nostalgia
fields.description: A playful 2000s-inspired template with bubblegum pinks, chrome text effects, bubble shadows, and rounded bubbly UI components. Ideal for nostalgic streetwear and trendy Gen-Z brands.

fields.name: Dark Atelier
fields.description: A dramatic, dark avant-garde template with pitch-black backgrounds, deep crimson accents, vignette effects, and elegant Cinzel serif typography. Made for gothic and dark fashion labels.

fields.name: Bohemian Earth
fields.description: An organic, earthy template with terracotta and olive green tones, blob-shaped images, rounded corners, and warm Cormorant serif typography. Perfect for sustainable and bohemian fashion.

fields.name: Pop Art Blast
fields.description: A vibrant neo-brutalist template with extremely bold colors, thick black borders, halftone dot overlays, and playful Bungee display font. For brands that want to stand out loudly.

fields.name: Glass Modern
fields.description: An ultra-sleek glassmorphism template with frosted glass cards, gradient mesh backgrounds, and clean Inter typography. Inspired by Apple and Web3 aesthetics for digitally-native fashion brands.

fields.name: Azure Resort
fields.description: A light and airy template with ocean blues, sandy whites, wave divider elements, and relaxed Lora serif typography. Designed for swimwear, resort wear, and vacation fashion brands.

fields.name: Grind Skate Co.
fields.description: A raw, grunge-inspired template with distressed noise textures, bold Bebas Neue condensed fonts, sticker-like overlays, and a punk aesthetic. Built for skate brands and streetwear rebels.

fields.name: Hype Sneaker Lab
fields.description: A dark, product-focused template with spotlight gradient effects, large product imagery with hover rotation, and Archivo Black display font. The ultimate theme for sneaker drops and hype culture.

fields.name: Haute Couture
fields.description: An avant-garde editorial template with asymmetric masonry grids, dramatic Bodoni Moda italic serifs, and unconventional layouts. Designed for haute couture and experimental fashion houses.
